_README: THE REGISTRY. Adding a test to this machine is one entry here. Nothing else changes - not the watchdog, not the scheduled task, not the status page. See README.md.

_fields.name: short label, used in the status page and nowhere else
_fields.enabled: false means the watchdog ignores it completely
_fields.dir: folder, relative to the repo root
_fields.exe: interpreter, relative to dir. Keep this python.exe even when windowless is true - see below
_fields.match: a substring of the command line that identifies THIS runner in the process list. Must be unique across entries.
_fields.windowless: true runs it under pythonw.exe, which has no console at all - nothing appears on screen, ever. `exe` stays python.exe so that `verify` still runs under the console interpreter; a test suite run under pythonw would send its output nowhere and report success in silence.
_fields.verify: args to run before installing, to prove the thing is safe. Install refuses if it exits non-zero.
_fields.log: where the wrapper appends stdout, relative to dir
_fields.paper_only: documentation only - the real guarantee is each project's own test suite, run via `verify`

runners.name: devig-recorder
runners._note: NOT a paper test - a RECORDER. It only reads public endpoints and writes SQLite; it has no order code and no credentials. It is here because it is the one asset that accrues in wall-clock time: a Kalshi market that closes is gone for good, so an hour not recorded cannot be bought back at any price. It has died four times (2.5h, 13.6h, 19h and a reboot) and nothing restarted it.

runners.name: devig-recorder-eu
runners._note: Second recorder, Champions League and Premier League only, own database file. It MUST have its own db: two writers on one SQLite died with 'database is locked' inside 19 minutes on 2026-08-09.

runners.name: factory-wide-depth
runners._note: NOT a paper test - a RECORDER, and the expensive tier. Walks the FULL order-book ladder on 36 market families that bot-hunt does not record at depth: crypto, economics, financials, commodities, elections. One request per market, 900 per cycle, measured at 160 s. It is here because a Kalshi market that closes 404s forever - roughly a 69-day rolling window - so an hour not recorded cannot be bought back at any price. Read-only public endpoints, no credentials, no order code; strategy-factory/tests/test_paper_only.py fails the build if any appears, and it also scans bot-hunt/src/venues.py because that module runs inside this process.

runners.name: factory-wide-top
runners._note: The BREADTH tier, and its own database file - two writers on one SQLite died with 'database is locked' inside 19 minutes here on 2026-08-09, so this is a hard constraint and not a preference. One exchange-wide sweep of every open market, 785 requests, ~10 minutes, top of book only. Writes a row ONLY when a quote changed, measured at 2.5% of writing them all, with a forced full snapshot every 12th cycle so that 'nothing moved' and 'the recorder was down' stay distinguishable (GUARDS #12). Covers 3,357 market families against bot-hunt's 19.

runners.name: devig-props-capture
runners._note: ARMED CAPTURE, not a recorder. Waits up to 72h for Pinnacle's player-prop board to open, runs the comparison once, writes reports/props_n3.json and exits. It is in the WATCHDOG registry -- unlike the earlier prop watcher, which a reboot killed at 15h of 48 -- because --once-only makes it idempotent: if the capture already exists it exits immediately, so restarting it forever is harmless.

runners.name: devig-paired-sampler
runners._note: Reads Kalshi and Polymarket CONCURRENTLY for the same market and records the measured gap on every row (median 84 ms, against record.py's 6.5 MINUTES). Recording only -- no credentials, no order code, no execution path. Writes its OWN database (data/paired.db) with its own single-instance lock; it must never share record.db, where two writers died with 'database is locked' inside 19 minutes.

runners.name: kalshi-archive
runners._note: NOT a paper test and NOT the recorder. Read-only public endpoints, no credentials, writes its own SQLite file (data/kalshi_archive.db) and never record.db. It exists because retention_rebisect.py on 2026-09-06 showed Kalshi's window ROLLS: the earliest listed settled market moved from 2026-05-25 to 2026-06-30 in 33 calendar days, and the tape goes empty between 68 and 69 days. HANDOFF.md section 2c claimed a fixed boundary and was wrong. Every day this is not running, one more day of the whole exchange's settled history is deleted and cannot be bought back at any price. Twice a day, because the walk takes minutes and the thing it is racing moves once a day.
